trace.query: MATCH p=(n0:Policy)-[:APPROVED_BY|HELD_BY*1..2]->(h:Person) WHERE n0.id=$seed AND type(relationships(p)[0])='APPROVED_BY' AND (length(p)=1 OR (nodes(p)[1].kind='Role' AND type(relationships(p)[1])='HELD_BY')) OPTIONAL MATCH (h)-[delegation:DELEGATES_TO]->(d:Person) RETURN CASE WHEN d IS NULL THEN nodes(p) ELSE nodes(p)+[d] END, CASE WHEN d IS NULL THEN relationships(p) ELSE relationships(p)+[delegation] END LIMIT 64
